issue_context.title: The log level when fetching next chunk failed is a bit high
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement
When fetching next chunk failed, it may be caused by the server canceled the SQL execution, and it's  message will finally send to the client, so it could not be ignored. But the current log level of it is ERROR, it is a bit too high, which makes some users concern about it.
comments: I found that sometimes this log still has unique value. It feels better to keep it as it is.

review_comments: It seems it's hard to reach this line in the unit tests.

Now tidb is in go1.21. in Go 1.21, The new [AfterFunc](https://tip.golang.org/pkg/context/#AfterFunc) function registers a function to run after a context has been cancelled. so maybe we check it to set log level.
I found that sometimes this log still has unique value. It feels better to keep it as it is.
